bagPolicy.summary: Framed or large backpacks are prohibited in the festival venue area. Review the current Festival Info & Policies for additional venue and campground restrictions.
bagPolicy.note: Camping-area and venue-area rules differ; check the current official policy before arrival.

parking.note: No specific parking options, pricing, or tips are mentioned on the provided page. Attendees are encouraged to check the official website for updates.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Electric Forest's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Electric Forest festival offers a variety of food vendors and artisan shops located in the Main Street GA Campground Hub/Marketplace. Attendees can enjoy tasty treats in the new Uplift Lounge, exclusive to pass holders.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Electric Forest, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Electric Forest's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Electric Forest. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Electric Forest. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
